objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed artifact in the P&R system representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions, or other controlled content that undergoes creation, review, release, and archival cycles.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the document in its lifecycle (e.g., In Editing, Under Review, Released, Out of Force, Archived)

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the document

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date when the document becomes effective

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date when the document validity expires

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of document (e.g., Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction)

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Short code identifier for the document

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled supplementary document automatically released with and archived alongside its parent document, subject to the parent's release cycle and versioning.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the attachment (follows parent document release status)

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the attachment

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary document not subject to release cycles or dual control, which can be added, modified, and deleted independently without triggering parent document versioning.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Boolean indicating whether the additional info is publicly visible

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A planned amendment to an existing document that does not affect the document's version history or current released content until implemented.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the change proposal (e.g., Pending, Completed)

attributes.name: scheduled_for_implementation
attributes.description: Boolean indicating whether the change is scheduled to be applied

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated or manually created request to review and extend the validity period of a document approaching expiration.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the request (e.g., Pending, Extended, Rejected)

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to declare a document invalid and archive it when it no longer requires active distribution.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the request (e.g., Pending, Approved, Completed)

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to restore an archived document to active status with a new version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the request (e.g., Pending, Approved, Completed)

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person assigned one or more roles in the document management system with specific read and write permissions.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Assigned responsibility role (e.g., Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator, Reader)

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users grouped by function, location, or responsibility for permission and distribution assignment.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifier of the user group (e.g., Reader - Document Management, Archive Group)

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: A business division or department to which documents may be addressed and assigned.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: A software system or tool referenced in or relevant to document content.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Initiate a new document in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type, optionally from a template.

attributes.name: document_type_selected
attributes.description: The category of document being created

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modify the text and structured content of a document using the integrated editing client based on the document's source format.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically transform the document from its source format (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) to PDF for web display.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Define or update standardized and custom properties of a document, including attributes grouped in categories such as Master data, References, and Authorizations.

evts.name: assign_authorizations
evts.description: Designate Users and User Groups to specific permission roles (Reader, Author, Co-author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator) for the document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Specify User Groups and Users who will receive the document via distribution by email or for acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: assign_reviewer
evts.description: Designate one or more Users as reviewers responsible for technical and formal checks of document content.

evts.name: assign_releaser
evts.description: Designate one or more Users as releasers responsible for approving and publishing the document.

evts.name: submit_for_review
evts.description: Initiate the workflow review step, assigning the document to designated reviewers for technical and formal validation.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Execute the workflow review step by a Reviewer, checking the document for technical and formal compliance.

evts.name: reject_at_review
evts.description: Decline approval of a document during the review workflow step, canceling the workflow for all subsequent participants.

evts.name: submit_for_release
evts.description: Initiate the workflow release step, assigning the document to designated releasers for final approval.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Approve and publish a document with electronic signature by a Releaser, making it available to authorized readers and updating its Valid From date.

evts.name: reject_at_release
evts.description: Decline approval of a document during the release workflow step, canceling the workflow for all subsequent participants.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Electronically sign a document during workflow to evidence approval at creation, review, or release steps.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Make a released document visible to readers in the web interface.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: Add a controlled supplementary document to a parent document that will follow the parent's release and versioning cycle.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: Add a supplementary document to a parent document that is independent of the parent's release cycle and versioning.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Withdraw a document from active circulation by revoking authorization, typically following an Override decision or at the end of an archive retention period.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Remove an archived document from the system after the defined archive retention period has expired.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Create a new editing version of an existing released document, retaining all data from the previous version which may be adapted.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Submit a planned amendment to a document without modifying the current released version or version history.

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Approve a Change Proposal and create a new document version incorporating the proposed changes.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: Initiate a request to check and extend the validity of a document approaching its validity expiration date.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Approve and apply a validity extension to a document, updating its Valid Until date by the configured extension period.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Submit a request to invalidate a document and archive it when no longer required for active distribution.

evts.name: approve_override
evts.description: Confirm the invalidation of a document and revoke all active authorizations except for the Archive Group.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Initiate a request to restore an archived document to active status.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Approve and execute reactivation of an archived document, creating a new version with restored authorizations and archived attachments.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Send document release notification to designated Users and User Groups on the distribution list.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Prompt designated Users and User Groups to actively confirm receipt and understanding of a released document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Execute workflow task by a User to actively acknowledge receipt of a document and fulfill the acknowledgement requirement.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Create a language-specific version of a released document content for readers in a different login language.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Execute the workflow review step for a translated document version to validate translation accuracy and completeness.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Approve and publish a translated document version with electronic signature, making it visible to readers in the corresponding language.
